steps.journalDescription: Kastor has explained that the plan to escape cannot succeed without the man who came up with it: Nándor. The catch is that he never made it out of the mine in the south west part of the camp. I will need to go down to the third floor and find him or his remains if I want Kastor to kick things off.

I made contact with Nándor in the mine. I can bring him back to Kastor whenever I wish, but Nándor has asked that we close the tunnel that the worms are coming from on the southern end of the mine's third level before we return to the surface.

I have collapsed the tunnel the worms were using to enter the mine, and now Nándor wishes to return to the surface to meet with Kastor. His hut is in the southwest portion of the camp, along the southern wall.
I was able to bring Nándor back to Kastor. Now we can finally move on with the uprising.
